import os
import sys
from copy import deepcopy
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())

from src.csv_exporter import export_csv
from src.dispatcher import export
from src.exporter import export_rows
from src.json_exporter import export_json

rows = [
    {"id": 0, "name": 'é,"line\nnext', "ignored": "value"},
    {"id": None},
    {"name": False},
]
original = deepcopy(rows)
expected = {
    "csv": 'id,name\n0,"é,""line\nnext"\n,\n,False\n',
    "json": '[{"id":"0","name":"é,\\"line\\nnext"},{"id":"","name":""},{"id":"","name":"False"}]',
}
for format, wrapper in (("csv", export_csv), ("json", export_json)):
    for entry in (export_rows, export):
        assert entry(iter(rows), format) == expected[format]
        assert entry(iter([]), format) == ("id,name\n" if format == "csv" else "[]")
    assert wrapper(iter(rows)) == expected[format]
    assert rows == original

    with patch(f"src.{format}_exporter.export_rows", return_value="shared") as shared:
        assert wrapper(rows) == "shared"
        shared.assert_called_once_with(rows, format)

for entry in (export_rows, export):
    untouched = iter(rows)
    try:
        entry(untouched, "xml")
    except ValueError as error:
        assert str(error) == "unsupported format"
    else:
        raise AssertionError("unsupported formats must raise ValueError")
    assert next(untouched) is rows[0]
